book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: رجعت للتاجر وحكيت له كل إشي.
sentences.en: I went back to the merchant and told him everything.
He came with me and saw the ivory with his own eyes.

sentences.ar: قال لي: إنت حر من اليوم.
sentences.en: He said to me: you are free from today.

sentences.ar: والفيلة أعطتك اللي ما بيعطيه حدا.
sentences.en: And the elephants gave you what no one else gives.
I returned to Baghdad with a great deal of money.
And from that day I never went to sea again.
Sindbad turned to the porter and said:

sentences.ar: شفت؟ كل قرش عندي إله قصة.
sentences.en: You see? Every coin I have has a story behind it.
And the porter said: and I am content with my bread.
